##### Project general facts

Bab Al Qasr Seaview Residence 51 is an exclusive 5-star branded residential development located in the prestigious Al Raha Beach area of Abu Dhabi, offering a refined waterfront lifestyle defined by elegance, privacy, and uninterrupted sea views. The project comprises 163 luxury residences, including a diverse mix of spacious simplex and duplex apartments, sky villas, and 5-bedroom waterfront townhouses, all thoughtfully designed to maximize space, natural light, and panoramic coastal vistas. With 100% sea-facing units and expansive terraces, the development creates a seamless connection between indoor comfort and outdoor living.

The project is enriched with an exceptional range of resort-style amenities designed to elevate everyday living. Residents can enjoy multiple swimming pools including beach-entry, family, and infinity pools, as well as landscaped gardens, outdoor lounges, and waterfront seating areas. Additional lifestyle features include a fully equipped gym, residents’ lounge, jogging track, sports courts, kids’ play areas, BBQ zones, outdoor cinema, and a variety of social and relaxation spaces, complemented by rooftop experiences such as sky lounges, yoga lawns, and dining areas with breathtaking views.

Each residence is fully furnished with premium global brands, reflecting a sophisticated and contemporary design standard. Interiors feature high-quality materials such as travertine marble flooring and elegant finishes, alongside fully equipped kitchens fitted with Miele appliances and designer sanitary ware by Armani/Casa. Smart home systems, stylish furniture, and integrated technology ensure both comfort and convenience, while select units offer private elevators, pools, and gardens, delivering a truly elevated and luxurious waterfront living experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Raha Beach comprises of four standout locations: Al Bandar, Al Hadeel, Al Muneera and Al Zeina; combined, the precincts offer fantastic facilities, including an exclusive clubhouse, retail outlets, and swimming pools; as well as an abundance of dining choices,landscaped lawns, and peaceful water fountains.

Al Raha Beach stands as a luxurious and captivating waterfront destination nestled along the pristine shores of Abu Dhabi. This master-planned community redefines modern living by seamlessly blending residential, commercial, and recreational elements in a harmonious coastal setting. With its stunning architecture, top-notch amenities, and panoramic views, Al Raha Beach offers a lifestyle of opulence and tranquility that reflects the pinnacle of Abu Dhabi's cosmopolitan charm.

Al Raha Beach is not merely a place to live; it's a destination for unparalleled leisure and recreation. The community boasts a wealth of world-class facilities, including pristine beaches that invite residents to unwind by the water's edge, exclusive gyms and sports centers that cater to fitness enthusiasts, and lush parks and landscaped areas that create serene spots for relaxation and socializing.
